success.description: A Your target assumes the form of a beast. Choose the beastform card of a beast whose form you can assume. The target can only use the physical characteristics and skills shown on the card. While in beastform, he can only use spells with the Beastform trait and cannot speak. He resumes his normal form when he is knocked unconscious, killed, or when the act ends, or you voluntarily end the spell as a manoeuvre. In any case, this card will not recharge until the end of the act.

boon.description: You may heal or inflict 1 normal wound on the target as he changes form.

conservative.requirements: 7 power, humanoid target within close range. You must have the ability to assume a beastform
